name: Ryuzu Meyer(OG)
description: Ryuzu Meyer was a kind-hearted half-elf girl who lived in the Sanctuary four centuries ago alongside Beatrice, Roswaal A. Mathers, and Echidna. When the Warlock of Melancholy, Hector, attacked the Sanctuary, she voluntarily sacrificed herself to become the living core of the barrier within a giant magic crystal, unknowingly serving as the genetic foundation for Echidna's immortality experiments and the Ryuzu clones.
